flags.message: The frozen band is `baseline` (sal-v4) although the snapshot already shows the two strongest cert-stage signals this docket carries: a Court-requested response (Sep 29 2026, after the government waived) and ten amicus briefs at the cert stage. Neither signal is a band input or a statpack cut, so the scored yardstick for this cell (the baseline band's bracketed reached rate, about 5% pooled over OT2017-OT2025) understates the population this petition actually sits in. I anchored on the band as instructed and adjusted upward from the record; noting it here because a response-requested cut (and an amicus-count cut) on the paid scored segment would make cells like this one scoreable against the right population.
